about: Joined the paper in 2009 as a subeditor. Writes the Friday column on transport policy, and keeps the style guide, which she describes as "a treaty, not a rulebook".
Covers the docks, the freight yards, and anything that moves goods through the city at night.
Ran the picture desk for eleven years. Argues, at length, that a caption is part of the photograph.
Freelance. Files on housing, planning appeals, and the long, dull committee meetings where both are decided.
